tagline: Track community projects on Trello straight from Discord channels
metaTitle: Discord Trello Integration: Create Cards from Messages
metaDescription: Turn Discord messages and feature requests into Trello cards and post card updates back to Discord. GAIA shares a daily digest. See the setup steps.
intro:
Source-available communities and creator teams often coordinate on Discord but track work on Trello. The gap between them means cards get created late, assignees miss updates, and contributors don't know what's been completed until they check the board manually.

GAIA bridges the two so community members can create and update cards directly from chat, and board activity posts back to the relevant channel. Your community's kanban board stays current without anyone having to leave the conversation.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Discord messages
useCases.description: A reaction or slash command in Discord triggers GAIA to create a card with the message content, assigned list, and due date. Contributors can submit work items without opening the board.

useCases.title: Post card updates to Discord
useCases.description: When a card moves to 'Done' or a comment is added, GAIA posts an update to the linked channel. The team celebrates wins and stays aware of progress in real time.

useCases.title: Sync feature requests to a Trello backlog
useCases.description: Feature requests posted in your feedback channel are automatically added as cards in the product backlog. Nothing is lost in chat history and prioritization can happen directly on the board.

useCases.title: Daily board digest for the project channel
useCases.description: Each morning, GAIA posts a summary of overdue and due-today cards to your project channel. Contributors know their priorities without a standup or manual board review.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Trello to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and your Trello workspace. Link specific channels to boards and lists.

howItWorks.step: Configure card creation and notification rules
howItWorks.description: Choose which chat triggers create cards and which board events post back to the channel. Set default labels, lists, and assignees for each channel mapping.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps both sides in sync
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles card creation and status updates automatically. Your community gets real-time project visibility without switching between apps.

faqs.question: Can community members who don't have Trello accounts create cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's bot acts as the account that creates the cards. Community members only interact with GAIA through reactions or commands.

faqs.question: Which list does GAIA add new cards to?
faqs.answer: You configure the default list per channel in GAIA's settings. You can also allow users to specify a list in the command at creation time.

faqs.question: Can I limit which Discord channels can create cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA only listens for card-creation triggers in the channels you explicitly configure. Other channels are ignored, preventing accidental card creation from casual conversation.
